source: Thaumcraft-1.7.10-4.2.3.5.jar thaumcraft/common/config/ConfigItems and ConfigBlocks, the getSubItems/getSubBlocks of each field's class, every constant ItemStack and world placement of a field in the original classes (javap -c -l -p, scripts/porting/legacy_bytecode.py) and thaumcraft_src/assets/thaumcraft/lang/en_US.lang; written by scripts/porting/extract_legacy_ids.py

policy.lookup: ItemApi.getItem/getBlock and ItemsTC/BlocksTC resolve an original field name through these rows first. A native id (thaumium_ingot, thaumcraft:thaumium_ingot) keeps resolving as before.
policy.id: the native item (kind item) or block (kind block) id, or null when 1.21.1 has no counterpart; the note says why
policy.state: block rows: the BlockState properties the original metadata selected; absent means the default state
policy.item: block rows: the item form of the metadata (the original new ItemStack(block, 1, meta)), or null when the block has no item
policy.component: the data component that carries what the original kept in NBT or metadata; described. ItemApi.getBlock sets only minecraft:block_state, for a state other than the default state when the item is the block's own item
policy.meta: 32767 is OreDictionary.WILDCARD_VALUE: one id when every metadata of the field shares it, else id null and the ids list
policy.evidence: Class.method:lines and Class:line are source lines of the original class files (LineNumberTable); en_US.lang names the original language key; (world) marks a world placement
